source.title: Upgrading and Preparation of Amended Comprehensive Land Use Plan (CLUP) for the City of Bacoor, Cavite — Ecological Profile

watercourseFindings.name: Imus River
watercourseFindings.sourceLocality: Bacoor City and upstream parts of Imus, Dasmariñas, Tagaytay, Silang and Amadeo; the source describes discharge to Bacoor Bay.
watercourseFindings.identityNote: The source provides narrative course context only; it does not provide a surveyed channel trace.

watercourseFindings.name: Bacoor River
watercourseFindings.sourceLocality: The source describes the Bacoor segment through several city barangays and names Daang Bukid Creek as a tributary.
watercourseFindings.identityNote: The alias is source-reported. Narrative route text is not channel geometry.

watercourseFindings.name: Don Cella River
watercourseFindings.sourceLocality: Bacoor City; described as draining the eastern part of the southern watershed and meeting Molino River at Molino Dam.
watercourseFindings.identityNote: The source does not provide a surveyed channel trace or station coordinates.

watercourseFindings.name: Molino River
watercourseFindings.sourceLocality: Bacoor City and Dasmariñas City; described as meeting Don Cella River at Molino Dam and spilling into Zapote River.
watercourseFindings.identityNote: The source does not provide a surveyed channel trace or station coordinates.

watercourseFindings.name: Zapote River
watercourseFindings.sourceLocality: Bacoor City boundary and adjoining Las Piñas City; the source names Bacoor barangays along the river.
watercourseFindings.identityNote: This is a cross-boundary lead; the source does not define its full course or geometry.

watercourseFindings.name: Ilat Creek
watercourseFindings.sourceLocality: The source describes it as a tributary to Zapote River that comes from the Dasmariñas City area.
watercourseFindings.identityNote: No channel line or station coordinates are supplied.

watercourseFindings.name: Daang Bukid Creek
watercourseFindings.sourceLocality: Bacoor City; the source describes it as a Bacoor River tributary crossing several coastal barangays.
watercourseFindings.identityNote: No channel line or station coordinates are supplied.

fisheryContext.sourceStatement: The city profile describes inland fishing in rivers and creeks, mostly hook-and-line fishing for household consumption, and says production is not significant.
fisheryContext.interpretation: City-level fishery context only; it does not establish species presence, abundance, date, catchability, or a complete inventory for any named river or creek.

damContext.name: Molino Dam
damContext.sourceDescription: The source places it at the Molino and Don Cella river confluence and reports a 9.11 ha land-use category.
damContext.reason: The reported value is a land-use area and is not identified as a surveyed reservoir water-surface extent.

limitations: The profile is a city planning document, not a fish survey or hydrographic survey.
Narrative watershed and river routes do not establish full channel identity, boundaries, or navigability.
Some named watercourses cross into neighboring local government units; the Bacoor lead records only source-described locality context.
No numeric salinity, fish sampling date, station, identification method, voucher, fishing access, current safety status, or current rule was established.
Item-specific reuse terms were not verified; publication approval remains false.
